english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone has no money available, with the context supplying the absolute sense.
Use this when “broken” means having no money or being broke.

examples.english: I'm penniless today, so I can't afford the bus.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 mou5 cin2 daap3 ce1
